subject: MAP: Security gating & DPA redline for EconoPay evaluation
messages:
From: Ana Velasquez <ana@econopay.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — security gates + DPA redline questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our evaluation team is pulling together a MAP and needs clarity on the security/compliance gates before we move to a pilot. A few near-term asks from procurement/legal: 

- Can you share your latest SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) and an up-to-date CAIQ/SIG snapshot?
- What is Redwood's default data retention policy and what levers do we have (custom retention per tenant, archival, deletion timeline)?
- Is a customer-managed KMS option available for encryption-at-rest?
- Any standard DPA we should review and a preferred channel for redlines?
- Do you support EU data residency for a customer in our EU region? If so, how long to provision?
- Escrow options or continuity assurances for high-risk financial workloads?

We're aiming for a 3-week MAP to pilot decision. I can loop in procurement/legal if helpful — procurement@econopay.com and legal@econopay.com.

Appreciate a short MAP-level response and suggested milestones so we can align internally.

Best,
Ana
Ana Velasquez
Head of Partnerships, EconoPay
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ana Velasquez <ana@econopay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates + DPA redline questions

Hi Ana — thanks, and great to hear the team wants a concrete MAP. High level response + proposed milestones below; Kim and Neha are copied to own the security artifacts and DPA review.

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: we can share our most recent Type II report (Q1 2026) under NDA. We'll attach a summary and CAIQ snapshot for initial review.
- Retention: default is 24 months for analytics/embeddings and 90 days for transient request logs by default; we can customize per-account (30/90/365/730 days) with an enterprise addendum.
- KMS: yes — customer-managed key (BYOK) via supported KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) for Dedicated and Private customers; hosted tenants can be offered KMIP/HSM integrations with an enterprise plan.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA; we'll upload a redline-ready copy to the shared link and propose tracked changes. We prefer DocuSign for final signatures.
- EU residency: supported via our EU cluster; typical provisioning is 7-14 business days after contract and capacity allocation.
- Escrow/continuity: we offer a continuity addendum for regulated customers (binary escrow option + documented recovery playbooks).

Proposed MAP milestones (3-week target):
1) Day 0–2: Exchange SOC2 summary + CAIQ snapshot and intake workshop (attach artifacts).
2) Day 3–7: DPA redline window; legal-to-legal sync call if needed.
3) Day 8–12: Security acceptance checklist completion (SSO, KMS option, data residency confirmation).
4) Day 13–21: Pilot provisioning (canary capacity) and operational runbook handoff.

Next steps from our side: I will attach the SOC2 summary and CAIQ snapshot, and Kim will send a short acceptance checklist. Can you confirm procurement/legal points of contact so we can route the DPA?

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of GTM Partnerships (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (attachment stub), CAIQ-snapshot-2026.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ana Velasquez <ana@econopay.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates + DPA redline questions

Hi Ana — adding a concise security acceptance checklist so procurement/engineering can mark the gate as met. Please treat these as acceptance criteria for the MAP security checkpoint.

Security acceptance checklist (recommended minimums):
- SOC 2 Type II report within the last 12 months OR SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter; if only Type I available we'll discuss compensating controls.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ snapshot for current production controls (we provided a CAIQ snapshot; request follow-ups on any control gaps).
- DPA with data processing terms that include: purpose limitation, subprocessors list, incident notification SLA (24 hours initial), and retention windows. Target retention: 24 months default; EconoPay may request 24-month contract lifecycle with optional 36-month archival — confirm which applies.
- Encryption: TLS-in-transit required; at-rest encryption with Redwood-managed keys by default; BYOK / CMEK offered for Dedicated/Private.
- Access control: SSO via SAML/OIDC + SCIM provisioning for user-sync during pilot.
- Evidence delivery: a secure link to SOC2 and SIG files; for pilot we can provide sanitized sample logs and architectural diagrams.
- KMS/EU residency: If EU residency is required, specify region and we'll include provisioning lead time (7–14 business days) in the MAP timeline.
- Escrow/continuity: We provide contractual continuity options; we can scope a short annex if this is a gating item for financial risk teams.

Owner suggestions:
- Redwood security artifacts: Kimberly Park (security intake)
- DPA redline coordination: Neha Kapoor (legal ops)
- MAP logistics and pilot provisioning: Michael Grant

I can prepare a redline-friendly DPA clause addendum template focused on retention and subprocessors for faster turnaround.

-Kim

From: Ana Velasquez <ana@econopay.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, EconoPay Procurement <procurement@econopay.com>, EconoPay Legal <legal@econopay.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates + DPA redline questions

Thanks Michael and Kim — this is helpful. Procurement and legal are looped in now (procurement@econopay.com / legal@econopay.com). A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: EconoPay's baseline is 24 months for customer data with a hard cap at 36 months for archival (we won't accept >36 months). Please confirm Redwood can commit to configurable retention windows and a process for verified deletion.
- DPA: we'll send a quick redline but appreciate a redline template focused on retention/subprocessor notifications. Legal will want the incident notification SLA spelled out (24 hours initial, 72 hours substantive).
- KMS: BYOK is preferred for the pilot if available; otherwise we need to understand the roadmap for CMEK in hosted environments.
- Escrow: our risk team asks for at least a continuity annex; it doesn't need to be full escrow but should cover inability to serve for 30+ days.

Attached is a short list of procurement/technical questions (econopay-questions-0831.docx). We'll coordinate a legal-to-legal call if we have substantive redlines.

Can Redwood confirm next available times for a 30-min intake to finalize MAP dates? We're trying to kick pilot provisioning by mid-September.

Best,
Ana
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ana Velasquez <ana@econopay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, EconoPay Procurement <procurement@econopay.com>, EconoPay Legal <legal@econopay.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates + DPA redline questions

Ana — thanks. Confirming next steps and a proposed short MAP schedule so we have alignment for procurement and legal.

Committed deliverables from Redwood this week:
- Share full SOC2 Type II report via secure link (we will request an intake NDA) and CAIQ/SSP artifacts (attached summary).
- Upload redline-friendly DPA to the shared draft link and highlight retention + incident notification language for Neha to review.
- Provide a BYOK/CMEK note for hosted vs Dedicated plans and our expected rollout timeline for hosted CMEK (target Q4 2026).
- Produce a short continuity annex draft (escrow-lite) and estimate for inclusion in commercial terms.

Proposed MAP timeline (three-week path to pilot):
- Sep 2 (today): artifacts shared + DPA draft uploaded (DocuSign link: https://docusign.redwood.ai/ECN-4921)
- Sep 3–7: Procurement/legal redline window; Kim/Neha available for legal sync on Sep 6 10:00 PT if that works for your team.
- Sep 8–12: Security acceptance checklist confirmations and signed DPA (target)
- Sep 13–18: Pilot provisioning (canary capacity) and SSO/KMS provisioning if BYOK is agreed.

Could you confirm the Sep 6 10:00 PT slot for a 30-minute legal/security sync? If that works we'll calendar invite and share the workshop agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
